instagram.title: Instagram
instagram.subtitle: Connect your agent to Instagram DMs and auto-reply to customers
instagram.prerequisitesDescription: Instagram DMs use Meta’s Instagram Messaging API. You’ll need an Instagram professional account connected to a Facebook Page, and you must enable Connected Tools access in Instagram settings.
instagram.connectedToolsPath: Instagram Settings → Messages and story replies → Message controls → Connected Tools → Allow Access to Messages
instagram.enableToConnect: Enable Instagram to connect and receive messages.
instagram.setPublic: Set agent visibility to Public to serve real customers.
instagram.setActive: Set agent status to Active to reply automatically.
instagram.connectDescription: Connect your Facebook Page linked to your Instagram professional account. Once connected, incoming DMs can be routed to this agent for replies.
instagram.authorize: You’ll be redirected to Meta to authorize access.
instagram.testDescription: After connecting, send a DM to your Instagram professional account from a personal account. If the webhook is configured correctly, the agent will reply automatically.
instagram.testTip: Tip: if you don’t see replies, confirm the Meta webhook callback URL and verify token are set, and that Connected Tools access is enabled.
instagram.sampleIncomingOne: Hi! I have a question about pricing.
instagram.sampleOutgoingOne: Of course — tell me what you need and I’ll help.
instagram.sampleIncomingTwo: Can you support Arabic and French?
instagram.sampleOutgoingTwo: Yes. We support Arabic (MSA + Darija), French, and English.

messenger.title: Messenger
messenger.subtitle: Connect a Facebook Page and reply to DMs with your agent.
messenger.connectDescription: Authorize Anselio to manage your Page messaging. You will be redirected to Meta to sign in.
messenger.developmentNotice: In development mode, Meta only delivers messages for app roles. For production use, you’ll need Advanced Access for permissions like <permission>pages_messaging</permission> via App Review.
messenger.webhookDescription: In Meta App Dashboard → Webhooks, set the Callback URL and Verify token, then subscribe your Page to the <field>messages</field> field.
messenger.missingAppUrl: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL to see your callback URL
messenger.sampleIncomingOne: Hi — do you have this in stock?
messenger.sampleOutgoingOne: Yes — I can help with that. What item are you looking for?
messenger.sampleOutgoingTwo: Got it. Let me check availability for black hoodie (M).
messenger.previewOnly: Preview only — real replies are sent via your Page connection.

phone.disabledDescription: Enable the phone channel above to connect your business number.
phone.yourNumbersDescription: These numbers are active and can receive calls.
phone.addPhoneNumberDescription: Connect your Moroccan business number. Callers to that number reach your AI agent.
phone.numberProvisionedDescription: Your number is ready. Calls will be answered by your AI agent.
phone.planLimitReachedDescription: Upgrade your plan to connect more phone numbers.
phone.callBehaviorDescription: Configure how the AI agent behaves during inbound phone calls.
phone.greetingDescription: First message the caller hears when the call connects.
phone.voicemailDescription: Automatically detect voicemail and leave a pre-recorded message.
phone.bargeInDescription: Allow the caller to interrupt the AI mid-prompt. The AI stops and listens.
phone.languageDescription: Auto-detect or set a fixed language for voice conversations.
phone.timeoutDescription: Max seconds to wait for the caller to speak before the AI prompts again.
phone.handoffDescription: When a caller asks for a person, Anselio transfers the call to this number.
phone.handoffNumberDescription: E.164 or Moroccan national format (e.g. +212612345678 or 0612345678). Required for phone transfers.
phone.handoffWarning: Add a handoff number to enable human transfer on phone calls.
phone.importantDescription: Changes to call behavior settings take effect on the next inbound call. Active calls continue with their original configuration.
phone.defaultGreeting: Hi, you've reached {agentName}. How can I help you today?
phone.importExistingDescription: Keep your IAM, Orange, or Inwi number. We register it for AI voice (BYOC). Your carrier or VoIP provider must route calls to AssemblyAI SIP — or dial USSD if a forward DID is available.
phone.carrierImportSuccess: Number connected — dial the USSD code next
phone.carrierImportSuccessDescription: Your business number is linked. Dial the forwarding code from that line, then test by calling it.
phone.sipByocSuccessDescription: Your number is registered with AssemblyAI. Ask your carrier or VoIP provider (BYOC/BYOP) to route it to the SIP destination below, then place a test call.
phone.sipByocInstructions: Step 2 — Route this number to AssemblyAI (BYOC / BYOP)
phone.sipByocStep1: Morocco does not allow reselling virtual DIDs. Keep your number with IAM, Orange, Inwi, or your VoIP integrator.
phone.sipByocStep2: Ask them to send inbound SIP for this number to {sipUri}.
phone.sipByocStep3: Then call your business number from another phone. Status updates after the first successful AI answer.
phone.sipByocActiveHint: Inbound SIP is verified — callers to your business number are reaching the AI.
phone.forwardingInstructions: Step 2 — Dial this code from your business mobile to activate forwarding:
phone.forwardingNote: After dialing, all calls to your business number forward to the AI. To cancel, dial #21#.
phone.forwardingLandlineNote: Landline? USSD may not work — set unconditional call forwarding to the forward-target number in your carrier account or app.
phone.forwardingActiveHint: Forwarding is verified — callers to your business number are reaching the AI.
phone.forwardingVerifyHint: Step 3 — Call your business number from another phone to confirm the AI answers. Status updates automatically after the first successful call.
phone.vapiSipDescription: Point a GoIP or SIPTRUNK.ma inbound trunk at this URI. Call the SIM after the box dials this address. No VoIPSense cartes required.
phone.vapiSipCreatedDescription: On the GoIP, set inbound GSM to dial this URI. Then call the SIM. For SIPTRUNK.ma, ask them to originate here or paste their cartes below.
phone.vapiSipInstructions: GoIP: forward GSM to this URI. Then *21* from the office line to your SIM.
phone.vapiSipLandlineNote: Landline: set unconditional forwarding in the carrier account to the SIM national number. Prepaid/Jawal often cannot *21* — the client needs postpaid.
phone.vapiSipForwardingCost: The client pays their operator for *21* minutes (often included in a forfait). Incoming to your SIM is free.
phone.importSipDescription: Paste SIPTRUNK.ma or VoIPSense cartes (server, username, password, and the +212). Call that number first. Then *21* from the client office line if they keep their own 05/06.
phone.sipDidHint: The +212 on the SIM in the OpenVox — not sip.vapi.ai.
phone.sipCarrierHint: Their published 05/06. They forward *21* to your SIM. Leave blank to test the SIM only.
phone.sipFieldsRequired: Enter the SIM number, SIP server, username, and password.
phone.sipImportSuccessDescription: Call the SIM first and confirm the AI answers. Then *21* from a real 06 to that SIM. Status updates after the first successful call.
phone.byoSipInstructions: Test the SIM, then forward the office line
phone.byoSipTestSimFirst: Call this SIM from another phone before forwarding. Do not reuse this kit for a second office.
phone.byoSipActiveHint: Inbound SIP is verified — callers to this SIM reach the AI.
phone.getNumberDescription: Optional platform DID when wholesale inventory exists. Prefer connecting your own number above (BYOC).
phone.provisionSuccessDescription: Your new Moroccan number is active. Calls to this number will be answered by your AI agent.
phone.freePlanTitle: Morocco telephony is included on Pro
phone.freePlanDescription: Upgrade to Pro or Enterprise for 1 Moroccan number with 300 AI voice minutes. Extra number packs, lines, and Meta accounts via sales — numbers are provisioned on SIPTRUNK.ma.
